metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience over 65 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in two specific regions in Queensland, Australia (Mount Isa and Townsville) during a specific time period (Jan 27-Feb 10, 2019). They want to know if these regions experienced over 65 centimeters of rainfall. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) IMERG data would be appropriate 2. Define geometries for both regions (I'll use points with buffers) 3. Filter the collection for the date range 4. Calculate total rainfall in mm (65 cm = 650 mm) 5. Check if rainfall exceeds 650 mm in each region 6. Handle potential data issues For data quality: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the results aren't NaN/None (C3) I'll use NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06 collection which has precipitation data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions around Mount Isa and Townsville const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.493, -20.725]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.817, -19.259]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-11'; // Exclusive end date // Load GPM precipitation data const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitationCal'); // Check if collection is empty const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { print("No precipitation data found for the date range."); print("C1"); return; } // Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // Function to calculate stats for a region function getRegionStats(region, name) { const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: region, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean = stats.get('precipitationCal_mean').getInfo(); const count = stats.get('precipitationCal_count').getInfo(); print(`${name}: Mean rainfall: ${mean !== null ? mean.toFixed(1) : 'null'} mm, Valid pixels: ${count}`); return {mean, count}; } // Get stats for both regions const mountIsaStats = getRegionStats(mountIsa, 'Mount Isa'); const townsvilleStats = getRegionStats(townsville, 'Townsville'); // Check for no valid pixels if (mountIsaStats.count === 0 || townsvilleStats.count === 0) { print("No valid pixels in one or both regions."); print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mountIsaStats.mean === null || townsvilleStats.mean === null || isNaN(mountIsaStats.mean) || isNaN(townsvilleStats.mean)) { print("Invalid precipitation values detected."); print("C3"); return; } // Check if rainfall exceeds 650 mm (65 cm) const mountIsaOver65cm = mountIsaStats.mean > 650; const townsvilleOver65cm = townsvilleStats.mean > 650; print(`Images in period: ${colSize}`); print(`Mount Isa >65cm: ${mountIsaOver65cm}`); print(`Townsville >65cm: ${townsvilleOver65cm}`); // Both regions need to exceed 65cm for "Yes" answer if (mountIsaOver65cm && townsvilleOver65cm) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
